question: Write a complete Lua 5.4 program that rolls a weighted loot table with a fixed RNG. Input: first line `seed R` (0 <= seed < 2^31), then lines `item weight` (positive integers) in table order. Starting with x = seed, each roll first sets x = (1103515245 * x + 12345) % 2147483648, then computes roll = x % total_weight and picks the first item whose running (cumulative) weight is greater than roll. Print the item of each roll on its own line, then `item count` for every item in table order (including zero counts).
reference:
local x, rolls = io.read("n", "n")
local items, total = {}, 0
for line in io.lines() do
  local name, weight = line:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+(%d+)%s*$")
  if name then
    local w = math.tointeger(tonumber(weight))
    items[#items + 1] = { name = name, weight = w, count = 0 }
    total = total + w
  end
end
local out = {}
for _ = 1, rolls do
  x = (1103515245 * x + 12345) % 2147483648
  local roll = x % total
  local acc = 0
  for _, item in ipairs(items) do
    acc = acc + item.weight
    if roll < acc then
      item.count = item.count + 1
      out[#out + 1] = item.name
      break
    end
  end
end
for _, item in ipairs(items) do
  out[#out + 1] = item.name .. " " .. item.count
end
print(table.concat(out, "\n"))
notes: Must advance the RNG before the first roll; integer arithmetic (no float division, no math.random); cumulative comparison strictly greater than roll; counts printed for all items in table order; R=0 prints only counts.

question: Write a complete Lua 5.4 program that parses an INI-style config from stdin. Lines are trimmed; blank lines and lines starting with `;` or `#` are ignored; `[name]` starts a section (name trimmed); otherwise the line must be `key = value`, split at the FIRST `=`, with key and value trimmed (the value may be empty or contain `=`). Lines without `=` or with an empty key are errors. Later assignments override earlier ones. Print `section.key=value` (just `key=value` for keys before any section), sorted by the full name in byte order, then `errors: K`.
reference:
local function trim(s)
  return (s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
end

local entries, errors, section = {}, 0, nil
for raw in io.lines() do
  local line = trim(raw)
  local first = line:sub(1, 1)
  if line == "" or first == ";" or first == "#" then
    -- blank or comment
  elseif first == "[" and line:sub(-1) == "]" then
    section = trim(line:sub(2, -2))
  else
    local key, value = line:match("^([^=]*)=(.*)$")
    if key then
      key, value = trim(key), trim(value)
    end
    if not key or key == "" then
      errors = errors + 1
    else
      local full = section and (section .. "." .. key) or key
      entries[full] = value
    end
  end
end
local keys = {}
for k in pairs(entries) do
  keys[#keys + 1] = k
end
table.sort(keys)
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
  print(k .. "=" .. entries[k])
end
print("errors: " .. errors)
notes: Split on first `=` only (url keeps `?a=b`); re-opened section overrides the earlier key; empty value allowed but empty key is an error; comments with leading whitespace; byte-order sort with unprefixed keys; empty input prints `errors: 0`.

question: Write a complete Lua 5.4 program. Input: `R C` (1 <= R, C <= 1000), then R lines of C characters, `.` open and `#` blocked. Count the paths from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell that move only right or down through open cells, and print the count modulo 1000000007 (print 0 if the start or end is blocked).
reference:
local rows, cols = io.read("n", "n")
io.read("l")
local grid = {}
for i = 1, rows do
  grid[i] = io.read("l")
end
local MOD = 1000000007
local dp = {}
for j = 1, cols do
  dp[j] = 0
end
for i = 1, rows do
  for j = 1, cols do
    if grid[i]:sub(j, j) == "#" then
      dp[j] = 0
    elseif i == 1 and j == 1 then
      dp[j] = 1
    else
      local left = j > 1 and dp[j - 1] or 0
      dp[j] = (dp[j] + left) % MOD
    end
  end
end
print(dp[cols])
notes: Take the modulo at every step (60x60 count is about 10^34, beyond 64-bit integers and exact floats); blocked start gives 0; 1x1 open grid gives 1; integer (not float) arithmetic.

reference:
class_name HealthComponent
extends Node

signal health_changed(current: int, maximum: int)
signal died

@export var max_health: int = 100:
	set(value):
		max_health = maxi(1, value)
		current_health = mini(current_health, max_health)

var current_health: int = 0
var is_dead: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	current_health = max_health


func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
	if is_dead or amount <= 0:
		return
	current_health = maxi(0, current_health - amount)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	if current_health == 0:
		is_dead = true
		died.emit()


func heal(amount: int) -> void:
	if is_dead or amount <= 0:
		return
	var before := current_health
	current_health = mini(max_health, current_health + amount)
	if current_health != before:
		health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)


# Usage from the owner (e.g. an enemy scene with a HealthComponent child named Health):
#   @onready var health: HealthComponent = $Health
#   func _ready() -> void:
#       health.died.connect(queue_free)
notes: Godot 4 signal syntax: `signal died`, `died.emit()` and `health_changed.emit(...)`, connection via `health.died.connect(queue_free)` (not emit_signal strings / connect("died", self, ...)); @export max_health with values clamped; class_name for reuse; died emitted once with an is_dead guard; current health initialised in _ready; typed GDScript (int/void annotations).

question: Write a complete LÖVE 11 `main.lua` for a tiny top-down shooter: the player moves with WASD/arrows (same speed diagonally), aims with the mouse and fires bullets while the left button is held (with a fire cooldown). Enemies spawn at the screen edges every second and move toward the player; bullets destroy enemies (+1 score) and an enemy touching the player ends the game, after which R restarts. Draw everything with simple shapes and show the score.
reference:
-- main.lua (LOVE 11.x)
local player, bullets, enemies
local score, spawnTimer, fireTimer, gameOver

local PLAYER_SPEED = 220
local BULLET_SPEED = 600
local FIRE_COOLDOWN = 0.15
local SPAWN_EVERY = 1.0

local function reset()
  player = { x = 400, y = 300, r = 12 }
  bullets, enemies = {}, {}
  score, spawnTimer, fireTimer, gameOver = 0, 0, 0, false
end

local function circlesOverlap(a, b)
  local dx, dy = a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y
  local rr = a.r + b.r
  return dx * dx + dy * dy < rr * rr
end

local function spawnEnemy()
  local w, h = love.graphics.getDimensions()
  local side = love.math.random(4)
  local x, y
  if side == 1 then x, y = love.math.random(0, w), -20
  elseif side == 2 then x, y = love.math.random(0, w), h + 20
  elseif side == 3 then x, y = -20, love.math.random(0, h)
  else x, y = w + 20, love.math.random(0, h) end
  table.insert(enemies, { x = x, y = y, r = 14, speed = 80 + score * 2 })
end

function love.load()
  love.math.setRandomSeed(os.time())
  reset()
end

function love.update(dt)
  if gameOver then return end

  local dx, dy = 0, 0
  if love.keyboard.isDown("a", "left") then dx = dx - 1 end
  if love.keyboard.isDown("d", "right") then dx = dx + 1 end
  if love.keyboard.isDown("w", "up") then dy = dy - 1 end
  if love.keyboard.isDown("s", "down") then dy = dy + 1 end
  local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
  if len > 0 then
    player.x = player.x + dx / len * PLAYER_SPEED * dt
    player.y = player.y + dy / len * PLAYER_SPEED * dt
  end
  local w, h = love.graphics.getDimensions()
  player.x = math.max(player.r, math.min(w - player.r, player.x))
  player.y = math.max(player.r, math.min(h - player.r, player.y))

  fireTimer = fireTimer - dt
  if love.mouse.isDown(1) and fireTimer <= 0 then
    fireTimer = FIRE_COOLDOWN
    local mx, my = love.mouse.getPosition()
    local angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x)
    table.insert(bullets, { x = player.x, y = player.y, r = 4,
      vx = math.cos(angle) * BULLET_SPEED, vy = math.sin(angle) * BULLET_SPEED })
  end

  spawnTimer = spawnTimer - dt
  if spawnTimer <= 0 then
    spawnTimer = SPAWN_EVERY
    spawnEnemy()
  end

  for i = #bullets, 1, -1 do
    local b = bullets[i]
    b.x, b.y = b.x + b.vx * dt, b.y + b.vy * dt
    if b.x < -10 or b.x > w + 10 or b.y < -10 or b.y > h + 10 then
      table.remove(bullets, i)
    end
  end

  for i = #enemies, 1, -1 do
    local e = enemies[i]
    local ex, ey = player.x - e.x, player.y - e.y
    local d = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey)
    if d > 0 then
      e.x, e.y = e.x + ex / d * e.speed * dt, e.y + ey / d * e.speed * dt
    end
    if circlesOverlap(e, player) then
      gameOver = true
      return
    end
    for j = #bullets, 1, -1 do
      if circlesOverlap(e, bullets[j]) then
        table.remove(bullets, j)
        table.remove(enemies, i)
        score = score + 1
        break
      end
    end
  end
end

function love.keypressed(key)
  if key == "escape" then love.event.quit() end
  if gameOver and key == "r" then reset() end
end

function love.draw()
  love.graphics.setColor(0.3, 0.8, 1)
  love.graphics.circle("fill", player.x, player.y, player.r)
  love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 0.4)
  for _, b in ipairs(bullets) do love.graphics.circle("fill", b.x, b.y, b.r) end
  love.graphics.setColor(1, 0.3, 0.3)
  for _, e in ipairs(enemies) do love.graphics.circle("fill", e.x, e.y, e.r) end
  love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
  love.graphics.print("Score: " .. score, 10, 10)
  if gameOver then
    love.graphics.printf("GAME OVER - press R to restart", 0, love.graphics.getHeight() / 2, love.graphics.getWidth(), "center")
  end
end
notes: LÖVE 11 callbacks (love.load/update/draw/keypressed) and APIs (love.keyboard.isDown, love.mouse.isDown(1), love.graphics.setColor with 0-1 floats, not 0-255); all movement scaled by dt and diagonal movement normalized; removal from tables while iterating done backwards (for i = #t, 1, -1); bullets aimed with math.atan2/vector normalisation; circle collision via squared distances; restart resets all state.

  if current and current.leave then current.leave() end
  current = states[name]
  if current.enter then current.enter(...) end

    love.graphics.printf("BLOCK DODGE\n\nEnter: play   Esc: quit", 0, 200, love.graphics.getWidth(), "center")
  end,
  keypressed = function(key)

    play.x, play.blocks, play.timer, play.time = love.graphics.getWidth() / 2, {}, 0, 0
  end,

    play.time = play.time + dt
    local dir = 0

    if love.keyboard.isDown("right", "d") then dir = dir + 1 end

    end
    local h = love.graphics.getHeight()

        switch("gameover", play.time)
        return

    end
  end,

    local h = love.graphics.getHeight()
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", play.x - 20, h - 40, 40, 20)
    for _, b in ipairs(play.blocks) do love.graphics.rectangle("line", b.x, b.y, 30, 30) end
    love.graphics.print(string.format("Time: %.1f", play.time), 10, 10)
  end,
  keypressed = function(key)
    if key == "p" or key == "escape" then switch("pause") end
  end,
}

states.pause = {
  draw = function()
    states.play.draw()

For every `print` output `dec=D hex=H bits=C`, where D is the register read as a signed 64-bit two's-complement integer in decimal, H is the 64 bits as exactly 16 uppercase hexadecimal digits and C is the number of 1 bits.

Popcount must terminate for negative values (loop while x ~= 0 with x >> 1, or 64 iterations); `while x > 0` or % 2 and // 2 arithmetic is wrong for negatives.   local cmd, arg = line:match("^(%a+)%s*(%d*)$")

  elseif cmd == "clear" then
    reg = reg & ~(1 << n)
  elseif cmd == "flip" then
    reg = reg ~ (1 << n)
  elseif cmd == "shl" then
    reg = reg << n
  elseif cmd == "shr" then
    reg = reg >> n
  elseif cmd == "not" then
    reg = ~reg
  elseif cmd == "print" then

    while x ~= 0 do
      c = c + (x & 1)
      x = x >> 1
    end
    print(string.format("dec=%d hex=%016X bits=%d", reg, reg, c))
  end
end

local W, H = 640, 480
local R = 15

  world = love.physics.newWorld(0, 500, true)
  world:setCallbacks(beginContact)

  walls = {}
  local function wall(x, y, w, h, tag)
    local b = love.physics.newBody(world, x, y, "static")
    local s = love.physics.newRectangleShape(w, h)
    local f = love.physics.newFixture(b, s)
    f:setUserData(tag)
    walls[#walls + 1] = {body = b, shape = s, fixture = f}
  end
  -- 20 px thick walls just outside the window edges
  wall(W / 2, H + 10, W + 40, 20, "floor")
  wall(W / 2, -10, W + 40, 20, "ceiling")
  wall(-10, H / 2, 20, H + 40, "wall")
  wall(W + 10, H / 2, 20, H + 40, "wall")

  ball = {}
  ball.body = love.physics.newBody(world, 320, 240, "dynamic")
  ball.shape = love.physics.newCircleShape(R)
  ball.fixture = love.physics.newFixture(ball.body, ball.shape, 1)
  ball.fixture:setRestitution(0.6)
  ball.fixture:setUserData("ball")

  floorHits = 0
  jumpCooldown = 0

  local ua, ub = a:getUserData(), b:getUserData()
  if (ua == "floor" and ub == "ball") or (ua == "ball" and ub == "floor") then

  end

function love.update(dt)

  end
  world:update(dt)

    ball.body:setLinearVelocity(vx, -400)
    jumpCooldown = 0.5
  elseif key == "r" then

    ball.body:setLinearVelocity(0, 0)
    ball.body:setAngularVelocity(0)
    ball.body:setAwake(true)
    jumpCooldown = 0

  love.graphics.setColor(0.9, 0.5, 0.2)
  love.graphics.circle("fill", ball.body:getX(), ball.body:getY(), ball.shape:getRadius())

  love.graphics.print("floor hits: " .. floorHits, 10, 10)

-- Scrolling camera with a motion trail (LOVE 11)
local WORLD_W, WORLD_H = 2000, 1500
local SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H = 640, 480
local TRAIL_MAX = 30

local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
  if v < lo then return lo elseif v > hi then return hi end
  return v
end

function love.load()
  player = {x = 100, y = 100, speed = 200}
  camera = {x = 0, y = 0}
  trail = {}
  marker = nil
end

function screenToWorld(sx, sy)
  return sx + camera.x, sy + camera.y
end

function love.update(dt)
  local dx, dy = 0, 0
  local down = love.keyboard.isDown
  if down("left", "a") then dx = dx - 1 end
  if down("right", "d") then dx = dx + 1 end
  if down("up", "w") then dy = dy - 1 end
  if down("down", "s") then dy = dy + 1 end
  if dx ~= 0 and dy ~= 0 then
    local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    dx, dy = dx / len, dy / len
  end
  player.x = clamp(player.x + dx * player.speed * dt, 0, WORLD_W)
  player.y = clamp(player.y + dy * player.speed * dt, 0, WORLD_H)

  camera.x = clamp(player.x - SCREEN_W / 2, 0, WORLD_W - SCREEN_W)
  camera.y = clamp(player.y - SCREEN_H / 2, 0, WORLD_H - SCREEN_H)

  trail[#trail + 1] = {x = player.x, y = player.y}
  while #trail > TRAIL_MAX do
    table.remove(trail, 1)
  end
end

function love.mousepressed(x, y, button, istouch, presses)
  if button == 1 then
    local wx, wy = screenToWorld(x, y)
    marker = {x = wx, y = wy}
  end
end

  love.graphics.clear(0.08, 0.08, 0.1)
  love.graphics.push()
  love.graphics.translate(-camera.x, -camera.y)

  love.graphics.setColor(0.2, 0.2, 0.25)
  for gx = 0, WORLD_W, 100 do love.graphics.line(gx, 0, gx, WORLD_H) end
  for gy = 0, WORLD_H, 100 do love.graphics.line(0, gy, WORLD_W, gy) end

-- 15-puzzle with mouse clicks (LOVE 11)
local N, TILE = 4, 80
local OX, OY = 160, 80

local function findBlank()
  for r = 1, N do
    for c = 1, N do
      if grid[r][c] == 0 then return r, c end
    end
  end
end

function isSolved()
  for r = 1, N do
    for c = 1, N do
      local want = (r - 1) * N + c
      if r == N and c == N then want = 0 end
      if grid[r][c] ~= want then return false end
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- slide the tile at (r, c) into the blank if they are orthogonal neighbours
local function slide(r, c)
  local br, bc = findBlank()
  if math.abs(br - r) + math.abs(bc - c) ~= 1 then return false end
  grid[br][bc], grid[r][c] = grid[r][c], 0
  return true
end

function love.load()
  grid = {}
  for r = 1, N do
    grid[r] = {}
    for c = 1, N do grid[r][c] = (r - 1) * N + c end
  end
  grid[N][N] = 0
  moves = 0
  rng = love.math.newRandomGenerator(7)
end

local function shuffle()
  local dirs = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}}
  for _ = 1, 200 do
    local br, bc = findBlank()
    local d = dirs[rng:random(1, 4)]
    local r, c = br + d[1], bc + d[2]
    if r >= 1 and r <= N and c >= 1 and c <= N then slide(r, c) end
  end
  moves = 0
end

function love.mousepressed(x, y, button, istouch, presses)
  if button ~= 1 then return end
  local c = math.floor((x - OX) / TILE) + 1
  local r = math.floor((y - OY) / TILE) + 1
  if r < 1 or r > N or c < 1 or c > N then return end
  if slide(r, c) then moves = moves + 1 end
end

function love.keypressed(key)
  if key == "s" then shuffle() end
end

function love.draw()
  love.graphics.clear(0.12, 0.12, 0.14)
  for r = 1, N do
    for c = 1, N do
      local v = grid[r][c]
      if v ~= 0 then

      end
    end
  end

-- Drop-down developer console (LOVE 11)
local utf8 = require("utf8")

local function addLog(line)
  console.log[#console.log + 1] = line
end

local function runCommand(line)
  local words = {}
  for w in line:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
  local cmd = words[1]
  if cmd == "echo" then
    addLog((line:match("^%s*echo%s+(.*)$") or ""))
  elseif cmd == "add" then
    local a, b = tonumber(words[2]), tonumber(words[3])
    if a and b then addLog(tostring(a + b)) else addLog("usage: add a b") end
  elseif cmd == "give" then
    local n = tonumber(words[2])
    if n then
      game.gold = game.gold + n
      addLog("gold: " .. game.gold)
    else
      addLog("usage: give n")
    end
  elseif cmd == "clear" then
    console.log = {}
  else
    addLog("unknown command: " .. cmd)
  end
end

function love.load()
  love.keyboard.setKeyRepeat(true)
  console = {open = false, input = "", log = {}, history = {}}
  game = {gold = 0}
end

function love.textinput(t)
  if console.open and t ~= "`" then
    console.input = console.input .. t
  end
end

function love.keypressed(key)
  if key == "`" then
    console.open = not console.open
    return
  end
  if not console.open then return end
  if key == "escape" then
    console.open = false
  elseif key == "backspace" then
    local offset = utf8.offset(console.input, -1)
    if offset then
      console.input = string.sub(console.input, 1, offset - 1)
    end
  elseif key == "return" then
    local line = console.input
    if line:match("%S") then
      console.history[#console.history + 1] = line
      runCommand(line)
    end
    console.input = ""
  elseif key == "up" then
    if #console.history > 0 then
      console.input = console.history[#console.history]
    end
  end
end

function love.draw()
  love.graphics.clear(0.15, 0.2, 0.15)
  love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
  love.graphics.print("gold: " .. game.gold .. "   press ` for the console", 10, 450)
  if console.open then
    love.graphics.setColor(0, 0, 0, 0.8)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", 0, 0, 640, 200)

      love.graphics.print(console.log[i], 8, 4 + (i - first) * 16)
    end

  end
